## 🛠 First PR Checklist – Let’s Get Set Up Right

Before we dive into building features, let’s make sure our foundations are solid. Please tick off the following:

- [ ] 🔐 **Set up your GitHub Token**  
       Ensure Actions run smoothly by creating a fine-grained personal access token.  
       [GitHub Token Setup Guide →](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/managing-your-personal-access-tokens#creating-a-fine-grained-personal-access-token)

- [ ] ✅ **QLTY checks are green** – Let’s start strong with clean, reliable code.  
       - [ ] 🧪 **QLTY coverage** – Tests in place for key areas.  
       - [ ] 🔒 **QLTY badges** – No critical security issues reported.

- [ ] 📘 **`README.md` reviewed** – Look out for Developer experience notes are helpful and up to date.

- [ ] 📄 **README includes project-specific info** – Setup, architecture, usage, etc.

- [ ] 🚀 **Deployment runs locally** – It works on your machine = good vibes for prod.

---

Once all of these are ✅, you're good to merge! 🎉
